title: 夜班清潔隊 側向走路 2 格像素圖集（AI 姿勢圖縮成 32×48 為底，江兆耘手修）
prompt: 【提示詞 1：造型定稿，ChatGPT】Generate exactly ONE image: a single character, side view facing right, standing, full body, centered. Not a sheet, not multiple variations.

Style: chibi pixel-art-friendly character, thick 1-pixel-equivalent dark navy outline (#0C2D5E), flat colors, one-step shading only, no gradients, no texture, crisp square pixels, simple readable shapes that will still read when shrunk to 32x48 pixels.

Subject: a night-shift office cleaner, 'the Night Crew'. A round-headed chibi worker in a deep indigo uniform (#3B3F8C with darker shade #2A2D66), indigo cap with a short brim pointing forward, small cream collar, dark indigo trousers, dark shoes. On the chest, a small plain golden crescent-moon badge (#FFE873), a crescent shape only, NOT a lightning bolt. Very sleepy, half-closed eyes, a tiny calm mouth, a tired but kind look. He pushes a small upright vacuum cleaner in front of him: the hand holds the handle, a grey vacuum body with two tiny wheels sits on the floor ahead, with a short nozzle at the front. The vacuum is clean and empty: no dirt, no dust, no trash, no liquid.
Background: plain solid pure white, no floor, no shadow, no scenery.

Avoid: text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, fake writing, logos, watermark, lightning bolt, sparks, dirt, garbage, blood, realistic anatomy, 3D render, photo, gradients, glossy highlights, multiple panels.

【提示詞 2：走路 2 格，附提示詞 1 選定的圖】The attached image is my pixel-art game character. Keep this character EXACTLY as attached: same indigo uniform and cap, same crescent-moon chest badge, same sleepy half-closed eyes, same vacuum cleaner, same thick navy outline, same flat colors, same proportions and size.

Generate exactly ONE image: a horizontal sprite sheet with 2 poses of the SAME character in a single row, same size, side view facing right, feet on the same baseline, plain solid pure white background, no floor, no shadow. Poses, left to right: 1. walk A: standing with both feet on the ground, pushing the vacuum cleaner forward. 2. walk B: mid-step, one foot lifted, the body slightly higher by one pixel, still pushing the vacuum cleaner, the vacuum shifted a little forward. Keep the torso upright. The character must look sleepy but never angry. No text, no letters, no numbers, no motion lines, no sparkles, no dust clouds, no dirt, no effects.
references: 美術指南 §5.7（夜班清潔隊：32×48 只畫側向 2 格加吸塵器，吸塵器只吸腺苷與散落文件，不畫污物）；制服色 3B3F8C / 2A2D66、月牙徽章 FFE873（§3 色表）
selected: 造型定稿與姿勢圖各選 1 張（生成圖未入庫）
